_comment: The demo-login policy predicate. Its own spec because a spec mutates ONE file and this guard lives in images/vfs/lib/demo-login.ts. The behaviour it protects is that a login program which is DEFERRED must not read as configured -- and the failure mode that motivated it was silent: a missing method threw, the caller's try swallowed it, and the predicate reported policy instead of reporting that it could not tell.
verify: cd host && npx vitest run test/demo-login-image.test.ts >/dev/null 2>&1

trials.name: a deferred login program still reads as eagerly staged
the per-file lazy registration half of the union is dropped
trials.find: return typeof perFile === "function" && perFile.call(fs, path) !== null;
